overview_description: Record, update, delete and read payments to suppliers, with their notes, files and the purchase credit notes they raise.
intro: A purchase payment records money paid to a supplier against purchase invoices. These endpoints record, update, delete and read purchase payments, list the purchase credit notes a payment raised, and manage payment notes and their files. This area has 15 endpoints, each available in all seven SDKs.
warning: **Deleting a purchase payment or a note cannot be undone.** Deleting a note file currently returns `404`.
notes: **Every JSON write body is wrapped in `purchase_payment`, and amounts are decimal strings such as `"1.00"`.** The note create and update are multipart forms.
**A payment needs `payment_method_applications`.** Each entry names a payment processor by `id` and an amount.
**Paying more than the invoices take raises a purchase credit note.** It appears in the purchase credit notes list with this payment under `purchase_payment`.
**The invoice-scoped create pays the invoice in the path.** Send only `payment_method_applications` to it.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records are under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is `true`.

endpoints.title: List purchase payments
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of purchase payments.
endpoints.description: Lists the purchase payments on the account, one page at a time, under `data`. Pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter the list as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase payment
endpoints.summary: Records a payment to a supplier and returns it under `purchase_payment`.
endpoints.description: Records a purchase payment, wrapped in `purchase_payment`. `payment_method_applications` says how it is paid, `purchase_invoice_applications` which invoices it pays, and `credit_note_applications` which purchase credit notes it spends. Paying more than the invoices take raises a purchase credit note.

amount.description: The amount paid with this processor, such as `1.00`.

payment_processor.description: The `id` of a payment processor from the payment processor settings.

amount.description: The amount, as a decimal string such as `1.00`.

purchase_invoice_applications.description: The purchase invoices this payment pays, and how much goes to each.

amount.description: The amount, as a decimal string such as `1.00`.

credit_note_applications.description: Purchase credit notes to spend as part of this payment.

endpoints.title: Delete a purchase payment
endpoints.summary: Deletes a purchase payment. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Deletes the purchase payment. The call returns `204` with no body, and reading the payment afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: purchase_payment_id
parameters.description: The purchase payment's `id`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase payment
endpoints.description: Returns the purchase payment with its supplier, amounts and the invoices, credit notes and payment methods it applies to, under `purchase_payment`.

parameters.name: purchase_payment_id
parameters.description: The purchase payment's `id`.

404.description: No purchase payment has that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Update a purchase payment
endpoints.summary: Changes fields of a purchase payment and returns it under `purchase_payment`.
endpoints.description: Updates fields of the purchase payment, such as `payment_note`, wrapped in `purchase_payment`. Each update raises the payment's `version`.

parameters.name: purchase_payment_id
parameters.description: The purchase payment's `id`.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase payment for a purchase invoice
endpoints.summary: Records a payment against one purchase invoice and returns it under `purchase_payment`.
endpoints.description: Records a purchase payment that pays the purchase invoice in the path. Send only `payment_method_applications`, wrapped in `purchase_payment`; the payment is applied to that invoice.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The `id` of the purchase invoice to pay.

amount.description: The amount paid with this processor, such as `1.00`.

payment_processor.description: The `id` of a payment processor from the payment processor settings.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase payment note
endpoints.summary: Adds a note, with an optional file, to a purchase payment and returns it under `note`.
endpoints.description: Adds a note to the purchase payment. Send a multipart form with the text as the `note` field and, optionally, a file to attach. The new note comes back under `note`.

parameters.name: purchase_payment_id
parameters.description: The purchase payment's `id`.

note.description: The note text. HTML is accepted.

file.description: An optional file to attach to the note.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase payment note
endpoints.summary: Returns one note of a purchase payment under `note`.
endpoints.description: Returns the note with its content, attachments and watchers under `note`.

parameters.name: purchase_payment_id
parameters.description: The purchase payment's `id`.

parameters.name: pp_note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

404.description: The purchase payment has no note with that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of the payment's purchase credit notes.

endpoints.title: Update a purchase payment note
endpoints.summary: Replaces the text of a purchase payment note and returns it under `note`.
endpoints.description: Changes the note's text. Send a multipart form with the new text as the `note` field and, optionally, a file to attach. The updated note comes back under `note`.

parameters.name: purchase_payment_id
parameters.description: The purchase payment's `id`.

parameters.name: pp_note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

note.description: The new note text. HTML is accepted.

file.description: An optional file to attach to the note.

endpoints.title: Delete a purchase payment note file
endpoints.summary: Removes one attachment from a purchase payment note. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Deletes one file from the note, addressed by its `uuid`. A successful call returns `204` with no body.
endpoints.warning: **Deleting a note file currently fails.** This call currently returns `404` "attachment not found", even for a file the note's file list shows.

parameters.name: purchase_payment_id
parameters.description: The purchase payment's `id`.

parameters.name: pp_note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The attachment's `uuid`, from the note's `attachments`.

204.description: The file is removed from the note.

404.description: Attachment not found. This call currently returns `404` for every attachment, including ones the note's file list shows.

limit.description: The page size the API applied.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.

prev_cursor.description: The cursor of the previous page.
